name: TMVR delivery
full_name: Georgia Tech telerobotic transcatheter delivery system for a mitral valve implant
group: Georgia Institute of Technology, RoboMed Laboratory (J. P. Desai; R. Qi, N. U. Nayar)
versions: 2020 IROS first robotic transcatheter delivery system (title); ICRA 2021, T-MRB 2022 and ICRA 2023 papers of Nayar, Qi and Desai (qi2023 refs. [18]-[20], not read); 2023 RAL telerobotic system: reinforced guide tube in a 24 Fr commercial steerable sheath, stronger actuation, waterproofing, stabiliser, wireless joystick (qi2023, full)
devices_driven: own robotic catheter (5.7 mm OD) on a 1.11 m reinforced guide tube inside a customised steerable outer sheath (VERGO, Duke Extrusion; 6.6 mm ID, 8.3 mm OD, 990.6 mm) (qi2023 Abstract, Sec. IV-A)
n_dof_detail: 4 (proximal bending +-90 deg, distal bending +-120 deg, prismatic 70 mm actuatable and restricted to 60 mm, distal torsion +-75 deg; qi2023 Sec. II)
translation_detail: tendon/tip-actuation (distal prismatic joint: the quadlumen tube is advanced by a Pololu 100:1 gearmotor through a lead screw on a linear guide; tendon-driven bending and torsion joints; actuation unit on a stabiliser with a linear guide rail; qi2023 Sec. II)
rotation_detail: tendon-driven distal torsion joint: two antagonistic tendons on a lead-screw holder driven by a DC motor with a 16:1 gearbox (qi2023 Sec. II)
sterility: N.R.; waterproofed with two three-way stopcocks for saline introduction (qi2023 Sec. II)
validation_detail: implant delivery in a realistic human cardiovascular phantom (United Biologics) with a ViVitro pulsatile pump (63.1 ml/stroke, 70 beats/min), one demonstration; tube validation with the implant free and against the leaflet; no animal study yet (qi2023 Sec. IV-A, IV-B, V)
key_numbers: joint tracking RMSE 0.20, 0.74, 0.02 and 0.17 mm (qi2023 Sec. IV-A); Maxon 0.5 W 8 mm DC motors (64:1 bending, 16:1 torsion) and Pololu 100:1 prismatic gearmotor, tendon force up to about 20 N (Sec. II); implant advanced 40 mm under the leaflet (Sec. IV-A); tip deflection about 2 mm during a 15 s hold (Sec. IV-B)
sim_model: analytical static deflection model of the reinforced quadlumen tube (eqs. 1-10), checked against ANSYS 18.2 FEM and a camera bench test in 12 configurations (qi2023 Sec. III-C, Table I); not a model of the whole robot
